analysis: The PR modifies only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. The changes are a date bump (line 3), a benchmark report schema 5 note (lines 583-588: prefillChunkTokens, maxBatchedTokensPerStep, soloPrefillStripeTokens recorded from EngineV2Factory.ProductionBuild.prefillGeometry, and a mismatch in geometry fails the run), and a new env-var table row for DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS (around head line 1755, which is outside the supplied excerpt). No executable code, auth, attestation, encryption, or trust-boundary behavior changes in this diff. The schema 5 text adds a fail-closed consistency check in benchmark harnesses only; it does not touch serving, the coordinator WebSocket contract (TB-002), attestation (TB-009/TB-011), or the SSD prefix cache (T-041). The documented prefill and step-token settings are scheduler tuning knobs. Their effect on cache scoping, TTL, or HMAC naming is not described, so T-041 mitigations are unchanged by this documentation. Remaining uncertainties: the actual source change behind these docs (EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift, the benchmark code) is not supplied, and the env-var table row at line 1755 is outside the visible units. If the new env vars are read in production serving, a later source pass could check whether they permit resource-exhaustion misconfiguration, which would be a local operator risk, not a new trust-boundary issue. Existing text such as the logout and revoke behavior, which matches the A-008 and T-053 descriptions, is pre-existing and not restated.
